rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a concrete committee-establishment template. Both directives move from describing a multi-faceted policy problem to creating an inter-agency committee, contemplate ad hoc participation, draw on relevant governmental or outside expertise, and assign the committee a coordinating or advisory role. C16 and C12 contain similar committee machinery, but C08 is strongest because it expressly discusses an Inter-Agency Committee and ad hoc participation. The child's less formal reporting arrangement appears to be an adaptation rather than a defeat of the relationship.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I think it would be wise to set .up such an inter-agency committee on an ad hoc basis. I am proceeding with this plan.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am also approving the establishment of an Inter-Agency Committee on Water Resources... The Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Health, Education and Welfare and the Director of the Bureau of the Budget will participate on an ad hoc basis.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive combination of establishing an inter-agency body and using an ad hoc arrangement.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: The committee shall undertake an extensive review of all aspects of water resources policy... utilize fully the skills and experience of the Executive Agencies.
shared_material.explanation: Parallel assignment to examine a broad set of industry or policy problems using expertise from relevant participants.

shared_material.child_excerpt: After careful study, and to conclude its responsibility, the committee would make its views known, informally, to the Secretary of Commerce.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Its recommendations for the strengthening, clarification and modernization of water policies... are to be submitted to me
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the committee's work with advisory findings delivered to a designated executive official, though the child's procedure is deliberately less formal.
